text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaagh, so lameeee!!

The Oka Sho concludes. Cries of regret over
failing to beat Daiwa Scarlet echo into the blue sky.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Lame, so lame, seriously SO LAME!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Losing is pretty lame, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And yet, the fact that I feel pretty refreshed
is what's most pathetic of all...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"The Classics are really something else...
This feeling that hits you right in the chest after the race..."

Her first Classic race. In her own way,
Vodka seemed deeply moved.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Vodka.
So, do you realize it now? Just how skilled I am.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Still, you've gotten stronger too.
Though you're still 'second best or worse.'

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Dammit, getting all cocky like that.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Still, don't you forget!
The Classic season has only just begun!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Next! Just you watch next time!
Next time, I'm gonna leave you in the dust!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm looking forward to it♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it's precisely because you're desperately chasing after me
that my brilliance stands out all the more.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I'm looking forward to the next one too.
And the Oaks as well."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Don't you dare run away!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My bad, Trainer. I couldn't get the win.
And on top of that, I ended up losing my cool.
choice_data_list: What will you do about the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The Derby...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ah—!

The heated battles with rivals. But we can't
just keep going unconditionally...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what on earth should I do?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna just give up after taking a beating from her.
Well, and I wanna get some payback, too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"More than that, I wanna run with her again!
'Cause today, she showed me something that worth it."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Besides... I've got another dream I can't give up on.

With the Oka Sho behind us, the rivalry
with Daiwa Scarlet holds even greater weight.

The Derby, or the battle against my rival?
This time, I can't choose both.
choice_data_list: What should we do about the next race for now?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
For now, huh... Then keep it set for the Derby.
However...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Let me think about it for a bit.
Actually, why don't you think it through with me?
Vodka's expression was heavy and dark.
